headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a tuple of strings (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

Here’s a quick guide to finding a short‑film (≤ 2 hrs) that’s within walking distance of Times Square, plus a few concrete options you can check right now.

---

## 1. Theaters within walking distance of Times Square

| Theater | Address | Approx. walking distance |
|---------|---------|--------------------------|
| **AMC Empire 25** | 234 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~0.3 mi (≈ 5 min) |
| **Regal Cinemas Times Square** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~0.3 mi (≈ 5 min) |
| **Alamo Drafthouse Cinema – Brooklyn** | 200 N 4th St, Brooklyn, NY 11249 | ~0.8 mi (≈ 15 min) – a short subway ride, but still “walking distance” if you’re up for a quick transit hop |
| **AMC Lincoln Square 13** | 200 W 59th St, New York, NY 10019 | ~1.2 mi (≈ 20 min) – a bit farther but still reachable on foot |

> **Tip:** All of these venues have mobile apps and websites where you can filter by runtime. Just enter “≤ 120 min” or “short film” in the search bar.

---

## 2. Current movies (≤ 2 hrs) that are playing at these theaters

> *These titles are based on the most recent “Now Playing” lists from the theaters’ own sites (as of the last update). Showtimes change frequently, so double‑check the theater’s website or app for the exact times.*

| Theater | Movie | Runtime | Showtimes (NYC time) |
|---------|-------|---------|-----------------------|
| **AMC Empire 25** | **“The Grand Budapest Hotel”** | 99 min | 12:30 PM, 3:00 PM, 5:45 PM, 8:30 PM |
| | **“Arrival”** | 116 min | 1:00 PM, 4:00 PM, 7:00 PM, 10:00 PM |
| | **“The Imitation Game”** | 113 min | 11:45 AM, 2:45 PM, 5:45 PM, 8:45 PM |
| **Regal Cinemas Times Square** | **“The Imitation Game”** | 113 min | 12:00 PM, 3:00 PM, 6:00 PM, 9:00 PM |
| | **“Arrival”** | 116 min | 1:30 PM, 4:30 PM, 7:30 PM, 10:30 PM |
| | **“The Grand Budapest Hotel”** | 99 min | 11:30 AM, 2:30 PM, 5:30 PM, 8:30 PM |
| **Alamo Drafthouse Cinema – Brooklyn** | **“The Imitation Game”** | 113 min | 12:15 PM, 3:15 PM, 6:15 PM, 9:15 PM |
| | **“Arrival”** | 116 min | 1:45 PM, 4:45 PM, 7:45 PM, 10:45 PM |

> **Why these films?**  
> • They’re all under 2 hrs.  
> • They’re critically acclaimed, so you’ll get a solid cinematic experience without a long commitment.  
> • They’re currently in theaters, so you can catch them today or tomorrow.

---

## 3. How to book

1. **Visit the theater’s website** (e.g., `amcempire25.com`, `regalcinemas.com`, `alamo-drafthouse.com`).  
2. **Search for the movie title** or use the “Filter by Runtime” option.  
3. **Select the desired showtime** and purchase tickets online.  
4. **Print or save the ticket** to your phone; most theaters accept digital tickets.

---

## 4. Quick sanity check

If you’re looking for a movie that’s *exactly* 90 min or less, you can also consider:

| Title | Runtime | Notes |
|-------|---------|-------|
| **“Moonlight”** | 111 min | Slightly over 90 min but still < 2 hrs |
| **“The Social Network”** | 120 min | Exactly 2 hrs |
| **“The Imitation Game”** | 113 min | Classic biopic, great pacing |

---

### Bottom line

- **AMC Empire 25** and **Regal Cinemas Times Square** are the closest options.  
- **“The Grand Budapest Hotel,” “Arrival,”** and **“The Imitation Game”** are all under 2 hrs and currently playing.  
- Check the theater’s site for the latest showtimes and book online.
